message.content: London’s official time zone is **GMT (UTC+0)** during the winter months, and it switches to **BST (UTC+1)** for British Summer Time in the summer. The change usually occurs on the last Sunday in March (clocks move forward one hour) and reverts on the last Sunday in October (clocks move back one hour).
